name: strconv
doc:
strconv: conversions between strings and numbers/bools, Go's
strconv with T! results. Errors wrap the sentinels ErrSyntax / ErrRange
(errors.Is works) and name the function and input, as in Go:
`strconv.ParseInt: parsing "12a": invalid syntax`. Float formatting and
parsing are C (runtime/src/std_strconv.c); the rest is here.

items.name: ErrRange
items.doc: ErrRange is wrapped when a value is out of range for the target type.
items.summary: ErrRange is wrapped when a value is out of range for the target type.

items.name: ErrSyntax
items.doc: ErrSyntax is wrapped when a value does not have the right syntax for the target type.
items.summary: ErrSyntax is wrapped when a value does not have the right syntax for the target type.

items.name: Atoi
items.doc: Base-10 ParseInt (Go's Atoi).
items.summary: Base-10 ParseInt (Go's Atoi).

items.name: Format
items.doc:
Formats v: integers in base 10, floats shortest ('g', -1), bool,
string as is, char as its UTF-8 text.
items.summary: Formats v: integers in base 10, floats shortest ('g', -1), bool, string as is, char as its UTF-8 text.

items.name: FormatBool
items.doc: "true" or "false".
items.summary: "true" or "false".

items.name: FormatFloat
items.signature: func FormatFloat(f float, fmt char, prec int) string
items.doc:
Formats f: fmt is 'f' (-ddd.dddd), 'e' (-d.dddde+dd), 'E', 'g' ('e'
for large exponents, else 'f') or 'G'; prec is the number of digits
after the point ('f', 'e') or significant digits ('g'); -1 gives the
fewest digits that parse back to f exactly.
items.summary: Formats f: fmt is 'f' (-ddd.dddd), 'e' (-d.dddde+dd), 'E', 'g' ('e' for large exponents, else 'f') or 'G'; prec is the number of digits after the point ('f', 'e') or significant digits ('g'); -1 gives the fewest digits that parse back to f exactly.

items.signature: func FormatInt(n int, base int) string
items.doc: n in base 2..36 with a leading - when negative.
items.summary: n in base 2..36 with a leading - when negative.

items.name: FormatUint
items.signature: func FormatUint(n uint, base int) string
items.doc: n in base 2..36 (lower-case digits).

items.name: Parse
items.doc:
Parses s as a T: any integer type (base 10, range-checked), float,
float32, bool or string (returned as is).
items.summary: Parses s as a T: any integer type (base 10, range-checked), float, float32, bool or string (returned as is).

items.name: ParseBool
items.doc:
"1", "t", "T", "TRUE", "true", "True" are true; "0", "f", "F",
"FALSE", "false", "False" are false.
items.summary: "1", "t", "T", "TRUE", "true", "True" are true; "0", "f", "F", "FALSE", "false", "False" are false.

items.name: ParseFloat
items.doc:
Parses a float: decimal or hex (0x1p-2), inf/infinity/nan, optional
sign, no spaces. Overflow is ErrRange.
items.summary: Parses a float: decimal or hex (0x1p-2), inf/infinity/nan, optional sign, no spaces.

items.name: ParseInt
items.signature: func ParseInt(s string, base int) int!
items.doc:
Parses a signed integer (optional + or -) in the given base (see
ParseUint). Out of int64 range: ErrRange.
items.summary: Parses a signed integer (optional + or -) in the given base (see ParseUint).

items.name: ParseIntBits
items.signature: func ParseIntBits(s string, base int, bits int) int!
items.doc: ParseInt with a result that must fit in bits (8, 16, 32 or 64).
items.summary: ParseInt with a result that must fit in bits (8, 16, 32 or 64).

items.name: ParseUint
items.signature: func ParseUint(s string, base int) uint!
items.doc:
Parses an unsigned integer in base 2..36, or base 0: prefix 0x, 0o,
0b or 0 selects the base and underscores may separate digits.
items.summary: Parses an unsigned integer in base 2..36, or base 0: prefix 0x, 0o, 0b or 0 selects the base and underscores may separate digits.

items.name: ParseUintBits
items.signature: func ParseUintBits(s string, base int, bits int) uint!
items.doc: ParseUint with a result that must fit in bits (8, 16, 32 or 64).
items.summary: ParseUint with a result that must fit in bits (8, 16, 32 or 64).

items.name: Quote
items.doc:
s as a double-quoted Zell/Go string literal: control characters,
invalid UTF-8 and non-printing runes escaped.
items.summary: s as a double-quoted Zell/Go string literal: control characters, invalid UTF-8 and non-printing runes escaped.

items.name: QuoteRune

items.name: QuoteToASCII

items.summary: Like Quote, also escaping every non-ASCII rune (\u or \U).

items.name: Unquote
items.doc:
The value of a quoted literal: "..." (escapes \a \b \f \n \r \t \v \\
\' \" \xHH \ooo \uHHHH \UHHHHHHHH), `raw` or a one-character 'c'.
items.summary: The value of a quoted literal: "..." (escapes \a \b \f \n \r \t \v \\ \' \" \xHH \ooo \uHHHH \UHHHHHHHH), `raw` or a one-character 'c'.
